title: Finite subfamilies of global generators on a compact open
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V and K opens with K contained in V and K compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let H be an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] of finite type on K [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], and let sigma be a specified global generating family for H restricted to V (an epimorphism from the free sheaf on sigma.I). There is a finite subset S of sigma.I such that the free map on S, followed by the given generating epimorphism, becomes epimorphic upon restriction from V to K. Neither V affine nor H quasi-coherent is assumed.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BB (17.9.7), proof: local finite generators, local lifts and finite subcover, specialized to the directed union of finite-generated image subsheaves of a specified global generating family; Lemma 01B8 (17.9.4). Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01BB and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01B8.

proof.text: For every point x of K apply the local finite-selection theorem to obtain U_x contained in K and a finite support S_x whose map is epi on U_x. These neighbourhoods cover K.

Apply IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover to this cover, and take the finset biUnion T of the chosen S_x. For each chosen support S_x contained in T, the subtype inclusion induces a freeMap. The coproduct universal property proves that its composite with the T basis map equals the S_x basis map. Applying overMap preserves this factorization, and epi_of_epi_fac implies that the T map is epi on U_x.

Prove the local-lifting criterion on the slice site by forgetting to abelian sheaves and applying Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi′. For W contained in K and a section on W, choose a selected U_x containing a given point, restrict the section to W intersect U_x, and use the epimorphism there to lift it on a smaller neighbourhood. Composition of restriction maps supplies a lift of the original section. The criterion yields the epimorphism over K. If K is empty the pointwise condition is vacuous and the finite subcover and support union may both be empty. This step is implemented by the proved private helper epi_overMap_iff_local_lifts using Mathlib Sites.EpiMono, together with the proved preservation of colimits by the module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetful functor; the stalk comparison lemma is not used.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Lemma 01BB finite-subcover proof, with local finite support isolated and the categorical local-lifting glue implemented directly in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finset_generatingSections_on_compact
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V K : X.Opens) (hK : IsCompact (K : Set X)) (hKV : K ≤ V)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [(H.over K).IsFiniteType] (σ : (H.over V).GeneratingSections) :
    ∃ S : Finset σ.I,
      Epi ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hKV)).map
        (SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)
          ((↑) : S → σ.I) ≫ σ.π))
